title: MOTION (HARRIS-DAWSON - JURADO) relative to funding for converting one (1) CARE operation day into one (1) CARE+ operation day in Council District 8.
text:
[Council File 26-1625; CD 8]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (HARRIS-DAWSON - JURADO) relative to funding for converting one (1) CARE operation day into one (1) CARE+ operation day in Council District 8.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE $206,000 from the General City Purposes Fund No. 100/56, Account No. 0622 (Additional Homeless Services - Council District 8) to the Sanitation Fund No. 100/82, Account No. 3040 (Contractual Services) to convert one (1) CARE operation day into one (1) CARE+ operation day in Council District 8.
2. AUTHORIZE the Bureau of Sanitation to make any corrections, clarifications or revisions to the above fund transfer instructions, including any new instructions, in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion, and including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers; said corrections / clarifications / changes may be made orally, electronically or by any other means.
